sub_sector.value: Human nutrition ingredients; feed additives; specialty gases and crop nutrients

manufacturing_type.detail: Produces choline, encapsulates nutrients, and chelates minerals. Repackages select gases for distribution.

product_complexity.detail: Develops science-based nutrition formulations, encapsulated nutrients for improved bioavailability, and chelated minerals.

production_role.detail: Supplies ingredients for human and animal nutrition and chelated minerals for crops. Repackages and distributes select gases.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves human food and health markets, livestock and aquaculture feed, companion animal nutrition, and crop nutrition.

notes: Balchem’s mix of make-to-order and make-to-stock production is unclear.
